modalities.evidence: functional and structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
The fMRI session consisted of three runs

output.population: 145 neurotypical Mexican volunteers with Spanish as native language, 79 females and 66 males, aged 17–35
output.summary: Six protocols combining functional and structural MRI with behavioral psychometric tasks to study pragmatic language, including a speech-act recognition task, in neurotypical Spanish-speaking volunteers scanned over four years.
